Sect. 6.3 'Phonetic inventory' (c. p.17) gives consonant/vowel charts for Ukpet-Ubeteng-Evia (prenasalisation, labialisation/palatalisation, 7-8 vowels, no phonemic length); Appendix E (p.50) has tone-marked 222-item wordlists for Ukpet (Akpet Central), Ubeteng (Betem), Evia with the caveat 'there was no in-depth analysis of tones or other phonological or phonetic features'. The words 'stress' and 'accent' do not occur in the report.
